link.title: Video tutorials for 3D Bits
link.description: Video walkthroughs of building real configurators with 3D Bits, from an empty store to a product a customer can buy. Watching someone build one end to end is often faster than reading through each feature separately, particularly for the parts that are hard to describe in text: how the Composer feels to use, how an option connects to geometry, and how a change propagates to the price. These tutorials cover material, colour and texture switching, working with 3D scanned products, and using the preview and viewer blocks in a live theme.
